hero.html:
Level 4 - Advanced 30 min LLD Principles

Anti-Patterns: God Object, Anemic Model, Midlayer Mistake

Patterns tell you what good designs have in common. Anti-patterns tell you what bad designs have in common, and they are what an LLD grader actually spots first. After this page you can name the eight anti-patterns that cost candidates offers, see each one in your own code, and refactor it out while the interviewer watches.
